summary: Prompt management app where users add/save prompts; next work is to sanitize pasted content (especially from Microsoft Word) across all text inputs while preserving basic formatting (line breaks, bullets, numbering).
architectural_notes: Implement global paste sanitization for all text inputs: convert rich text/HTML paste to safe, clean plain text while preserving basic structure (newlines, bullets, numbering).
known_issues: Pasting content from Microsoft Word into text fields includes hidden HTML/CSS and formatting junk instead of clean text.

existing_features.title: Implement a paste-cleaning utility that removes Microsoft Word/HTML/CSS junk and yields clean plain text while preserving basic structure (line breaks, bullets, numbering, and tabs/indentation) so that pasting Word content does not insert CSS/HTML comments into the saved text.

Apply the Word paste-cleaning behavior to every user-editable text entry surface in the app, including the rich text prompt content editor and all standard text inputs used for titles, search, category creation/rename, and any other editable fields present in the UI.

Harden HTML sanitization so that if any HTML is still introduced (e.g., via non-Word sources or browser quirks), Word-specific and unsafe nodes (such as style/script/head/meta/link and HTML comments) never render as visible text in prompt display components.

new_feature_requests.summary: Clean up Microsoft Word paste: strip Word/HTML/CSS junk while preserving basic formatting (line breaks, bullets, numbering) across all text entry fields
